The initial integrated run failed three assertions and aborted on an accumulated async-stack overflow. The active loop is heap-pinned; the instrumented delegated-budget regression passed with the default thread stack. A subsequent namespaced run exposed two legacy evidence tests relying on byte-triggered reduction; corrected tests explicitly request compaction before this independent passing run.

The default HTML/report scans cached artifacts and is diagnostic. Published totals use the explicit current-object export and validated full source inventory. The known unavailable distribution standard-library thread-local source matches prior scope.
